(AP) — Freshman Kate Harpring scored 28 points and No. 24 North Carolina beat Texas Tech 61-47 on Thursday at the WBCA Showcase. Harpring, a 5-foot-10 guard who scored 30 last time out in a victory over Pennsylvania, made 11 of 24 shots and 6 of 10 at the foul line for the Tar Heels (3-2), who have won three in a row. She added five rebounds, four assists, and five steals. Ambrosia Cole led the Lady Raiders (4-1) with 15 points. Destinee Hooks totaled 13 points and seven rebounds, while reserve Martina Anyango pitched in with nine points and nine rebounds.

Currently, CTE can only be detected after someone has died. As of now, CTE can be diagnosed only after death , through direct study and dissection of the brain. However, two studies published this week in the Journal of the American Medical Association (JAMA) both point to the possibility of detecting CTE through blood tests. The first study was published by a research group with the Washington University School of Medicine on Nov. 13; the second , from researchers at Boston University and Banner Health, was published Thursday. Both indicate the presence of biomarkers in the blood that correlate with the presence of CTE.

Formula 1 will begin introducing full-time stewards in 2027, in a move designed to bring greater continuity to race officiating. But the FIA’s announcement is not a promise that controversial decisions will vanish overnight. The governing body says it will recruit a small number of experienced international stewards for a phased introduction next season. The long-term target is a department of 12 to 15 full-time officials, with the group expected to expand from 2028 onwards. Existing part-time stewards will remain involved, and the FIA says driver stewards will continue to contribute their specialist experience at events.

FCC preempts state rules that require AT&T to keep offering home phone service. AT&T’s status as a Carrier of Last Resort in California requires it to offer telephone service to any potential customer in its territory. AT&T wants to stop offering basic phone service to new customers and discontinue service for 184,000 residential customers and 15,000 business customers on June 1, 2027. The order released today granted AT&T’s request to preempt state rules, following up on the FCC’s previous approval of AT&T’s petition to discontinue service. AT&T had tried to achieve the same result in court, but a federal judge rejected its request to override California’s rules in July.

Melton, 25, was converted to a starting role last season and has pitched to an 11-7 record with a 2.76 ERA across 160 career innings. He was especially stellar last July, when he recorded a 0.92 ERA in 29 ⅓ innings across five starts. Melton would have reached free agency after the 2031 season, so the extension gives Detroit at least an extra two years of control over him, as well as buying out his arbitration years.

A Los Angeles County jury has found Jonathan Rinderknecht guilty of starting a blaze that erupted into the deadly and destructive Palisades Fire in 2025. That fire eventually grew into the deadly Palisades Fire several days later.

The Common Cents Act established guidelines for businesses and consumers when conducting cash transactions. President Trump on Friday signed the Common Cents Act , which lets businesses round cash transactions to the nearest nickel, into law. It sets standards for cash transactions that businesses and consumers can use when exact change isn't available, as the penny is phased out. The legislation calls for cash transactions to be rounded up or down to the nearest 5 cents. For example, if a purchase costs $10.02 after tax and a customer is short 2 cents, the tab would round down to $10 under the act. A charge of $10.04 would round up to $10.05.

Photographer who captured the humanity of subjects including Queen Elizabeth II, Dirk Bogarde, Jean-Michel Basquiat and Tom Stoppard In 1963, the photographer Dmitri Kasterine heard that Stanley Kubrick was in London filming Dr Strangelove. Kasterine was a fan, so he approached the editor of Queen magazine and successfully pitched a feature on the director at work. Kubrick noticed him on set and said: “Would you like to come and work for me? You stand in the right place.” Kasterine worked for Kubrick from 1963 to 1971, taking the stills on Dr Strangelove, 2001: A Space Odyssey and A Clockwork Orange. Kubrick taught the photographer the importance of courage, patience and perseverance.

Professional long driver Averee Dovsek shares one of the most underrated putting tips to help golfers understand how uphill and downhill slopes affect the overall break of a putt. After a scary tangle with Quinton Byfield in overtime left Auston Matthews doubled over, Jim Hiller says the Maple Leafs captain is fine, a rare bit of good news for a team stuck in an eight-game winless streak. Matthews got tangled up with Kings forward Quinton Byfield as he tried to cut toward the middle of the ice late in the extra period. Byfield came down on top of him, and Matthews immediately grabbed at his side, grimacing as he skated slowly to the bench. The sight of the Leafs' top centre doubled over raised immediate concern given his injury history , but he stayed in the game and opened the shootout for Toronto.
